title: WTO | resources gateway | WTO bookshop
content:
WTO | resources gateway | WTO bookshop
The WTO Bookshop offers more than 1,000 titles covering all aspects of world trade. The most recent WTO publications can be found alongside titles from over 50 publishers. The bookshop also offers exclusive gifts and souvenirs bearing the WTO logo. The souvenir catalogue is available
A valid passport or ID card is required
to see what is available right now — from bestsellers to new  arrivals.
The bookshop is open from Monday to Friday from 9h00 to  12h30 and in the afternoons from 14h00 to 17h00. A valid passport or ID card is  required to enter WTO premises.
You can also consult the WTO online bookshop or browse  through our non-WTO titles catalogue and place an order in three simple steps:
Send an email (containing your selections and contact details) to
You will be contacted within 24-48 hours to arrange payment. Credit card  payment can be arranged immediately over the phone.
You may receive your books in three ways:
Free of charge pick-up from the bookshop
Free of charge shipment within Switzerland
Shipment outside of Switzerland, with a 15% shipment charge added to your bill.
If you wish to  purchase WTO publications, these can be ordered directly from the
